text:
maya_csm: Kicking off Sunflow Labs pilot onboarding. Customer contacts: Elena (product lead) + Sam (infra). Core ask: integrate Redwood embeddings + chat for support routing. Goal: pilot live in ~30 days, success criteria below.

jonathan_se: Quick q — is Sunflow on GCP only? affects connector work and dedicated vs hosted decision.

maya_csm: They're primarily GCP us-central with a staging AWS account. We'll propose hosted API for speed, Dedicated later if needed.

kevin_enablement: I'll run enablement: recommend 2 sessions — \"Intro + runbook\" and \"Prompting & evals\". Who should be invited from Sunflow?

maya_csm: Elena + Sam + 1 eng manager + 1 data person. Proposed times: week of Apr 7 and Apr 14.

zoe_successops: Risk note: renewal signal is weak (pilot budget constrained). Track usage and quality metrics closely; set 2 escalation triggers: <50% of planned test traffic by D14, or QA pass rate <80% on our sample prompts.

jonathan_se: Tech checklist (quick):
```
- API keys & network allowlist (Sunflow infra)
- Sample dataset export (anonymized)
- Test prompts + golden answers
- Latency SLA expectations (p95 target: <350ms)
```

maya_csm: Timeline (high level):
- Day 0 (kickoff): stakeholder intro + goals
- D0–D7: env prep, keys, sample data transfer
- D8–D14: integration + smoke tests
- D15–D21: enablement + evaluation runs
- D22–D30: pilot polish + go-live decision

kevin_enablement: I'll prepare the runbook template and share before workshop.

jonathan_se: For staging/latency testing, can we request a small traffic replay? a 10k-request batch to emulate support volume.

onboard-bot: Meeting scheduled: \"Sunflow Pilot Kickoff\" on 2024-04-01 16:00 PDT — invites sent to maya_csm, jonathan_se, kevin_enablement, elena_sunflow.

maya_csm: Capture success criteria here — please confirm edits:
- Integration completed with sample dataset
- 80%+ correctness on eval prompt set
- p95 latency <350ms in staging under typical load
- Eng team able to run daily evals and see regressions

zoe_successops: Add renewal-related deliverables: weekly traction report for execs + one decision checkpoint at D30 (go/no-go + recommended commercial path).

maya_csm: Assigned owners:
- Integration owner: jonathan_se
- Enablement & runbook: kevin_enablement
- Success metrics & weekly report: zoe_successops
- Primary CSM: maya_csm

jonathan_se: I'll spin up the API key test harness and post curl examples tonight.

kevin_enablement: Noted. I'll create a short pre-read for the customer (what to send us, expected artifacts).

maya_csm: Action items recap (short):
- jonathan_se: curl examples + test harness (by EOD)
- kevin_enablement: runbook + pre-read (by Mon)
- zoe_successops: weekly report template + success dashboard draft (by Wed)
- maya_csm: confirm meeting agenda + invite list (by EOD)

jonathan_se: ack.

kevin_enablement: ack 

zoe_successops: ack, adding the risk flags to the dashboard now.

maya_csm: Thanks team. Will post the kickoff notes and upload the shared checklist after the meeting. :raised_hands:
